reg5.notes: Pololu S13V30F5 #4082. 5 V output. Current capability depends on battery voltage and temperature.

reg3.notes: Pololu S13V25F3 #4980. 3.3 V output. Verify purchased variant.

sd.notes: Adafruit 4682, 3 V logic only; SPI or SDIO. Header installation not represented.

esp.notes: Confirmed N8R8; dimensioned reconstruction. Breadboard firmware uses GPIO47 (J3.17) for SD CMD to avoid the GPIO38 RGB LED on V1.1. Custom PCB firmware retains GPIO38. GPIO47 is reserved for SD in the breadboard and cannot also serve expansion SDA.

battery.status: Published envelope; leads and connector approximate
battery.notes: Adafruit 328 protected 1S 3.7 V 2500 mAh. Runtime requires measurement.

myo.notes: Front-view solder pads labeled VIN/GND/RAW from manufacturer advanced guide. Use pad labels, not snap connectors or ENV. Coordinates illustrative.

ldo.status: Header coordinates and electrical mapping from manufacturer Eagle CAD
ldo.dimensions: 2.54 mm pin pitch; rows 7.62 mm apart; body illustrative
ldo.notes: TPS7A2030PDBVR on top SOT23-6 footprint: chip pin 5 OUT lands on carrier pad 6, JP1.1; middle carrier pad 5 unused.

adc.notes: CN1 and CN2 label order mapped from supplied top/underside photos. Header pitch assumed 2.54 mm; body envelope unmeasured. VIO-to-chip continuity, SP/8080 selection, STBY and reference configuration remain untested. See photo-pinmaps.md.

pending.notes: Exact carrier SKU and mechanical drawing required before a physical wiring layout can be released.

adapter.status: Header coordinates and electrical mapping from manufacturer Eagle CAD
adapter.dimensions: 2.54 mm pin pitch; rows 7.62 mm apart; body illustrative
adapter.notes: Adafruit 1230. Q1 bottom-side carrier for BAV199 or 2N7002; see adapter assembly drawing. Soldered units untested.

icm.status: Selected MIKROE-4237; manufacturer STEP, DXF and schematic
icm.dimensions: CAD mesh bounds 25.78 × 42.93 × 12.19 mm including headers; web listing dimension differs
icm.notes: JP2-JP4 SPI 1-2. Header map from v100. Check received board revision and dimensional discrepancy before mounting. No board has been measured.

ads-evm.status: Selected TI ADS131M04EVM; required rework documented
ads-evm.dimensions: Body/positions illustrative; connector identities from TI manual
ads-evm.notes: PHI removed. TP2=3.0 V; TP1=3.3 V. Follow EVM adaptation before use.
